title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.35880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. translated_title: 离线强化学习中从静态策略到自适应先验的转变
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习（RL）传统上专注于在保守目标下学习可直接部署的策略，其中对离线数据集之外的不确定性采取悲观处理以确保鲁棒性。我们认为，当离线训练的策略随后通过在线交互进行更新时，这一设定变得不再完整——随着测试时自适应和在线微调在现代智能系统中的日益普及，这种情况正越来越多地出现。本立场论文认为，在此类场景下，离线RL的目标应超越即时部署，而应优先学习自适应策略先验：即通过记忆、探索和自我纠正，保留在后续交互中持续改进能力的策略。我们将这一观点形式化为自适应离线强化学习（AORL），将其与离线到在线RL相区分，并解释了为什么适应性在此类设定下变得重要。
tldr: 本论文主张离线强化学习的目标应从学习用于直接部署的静态保守策略，转变为学习通过记忆、探索和自我纠正保留后续在线交互改进能力的自适应策略先验，并将这一新范式形式化为自适应离线强化学习（AORL）。
en_tdlr: This position paper argues that offline RL should shift from learning static conservative policies for direct deployment to learning adaptive policy priors that preserve the capacity to improve through memory, exploration, and self-correction during subsequent online interaction, formalizing this perspective as Adaptive Offline Reinforcement Learning (AORL).
